Appraiser's Office
The County Appraiser, with the assistance of staff members, is responsible for the discovery, listing, and the uniform and equitable appraisal of all taxable and exempt real and personal property in compliance with the constitution and statutes of the State of Kansas for tax purposes.
Court
District Courts are created by the Constitution. They are the record and trial courts of Kansas, with general original jurisdiction over all civil and criminal cases, including divorce and domestic relations, damage suits, probate and administration of estates, guardianships, conservatorships, care of the mentally ill, juvenile matters, and small claims. It is here that the criminal and civil jury trials are held. District courts also have appellate jurisdiction over municipal courts. Appeals may be taken from the district courts to the Court of Appeals, or to the Supreme Court.
Emergency Medical Services
The primary purpose of the Meade County Emergency Medical Service (EMS) is to provide effective, efficient pre-hospital care and transportation by trained personnel. With proper assessment, adequate treatment and skills, and prompt transport, the initial patient management will save lives.

Extension
Since 1914, K-State Research & Extension has provided practical, trustworthy education to the people of Kansas. Here in Meade County, Extension services are available to citizens in the areas of 4-H, Family & Consumer Sciences, Horticulture, Agriculture, and Aging. Our focus in Kansas is on solving grand challenges in our state pertaining to water, health, global food systems, vitalizing our communities, and developing tomorrow's leaders.
Fire
The purpose of the Meade Rural Fire Department is to serve our community with courage and braver, being knowledgeable, efficient, and safe in our efforts to protect the people and property. Our goal is to educate the public on Fire Prevention and Safety.

Health
The mission of Meade County Health Department is to prevent disease, promote wellness, and protect the health of the citizens of Meade County.
Noxious Weed
The Meade County Weed Department administers the Kansas Noxious Weed Law (KSA 2-1314) in Meade County. We treat all noxious weeds found on county property and contract with Kansas Department of Transportation, railroads, townships, and individuals to treat noxious weeds. We also share the cost of herbicides required by landowners and operators in the county to treat noxious weeds on their property.
Public Works
The responsibilities of the Public Works Office include the administration and operation of the Road and Bridge Department, Disposal Department (formerly named Utility Department), Meade County Landfill, and much more.

NOTICE OF BOND ELECTION
UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 476,
GRAY COUNTY, KANSAS (COPELAND)
The Board of Education of Unified School District No. 476, Gray County, Kansas (Copeland) (the “District”), has heretofore, pursuant to resolution duly adopted, declared it advisable to make and finance certain improvements to District facilities pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 10‑101 et seq ., K.S.A. 25‑2018(f), K.S.A. 72‑5457, and K.S.A. 72‑5458 et seq . Notice is hereby given to the qualified electors of the District that a bond election has been called and will be held on November 3, 2026, for the purpose of submitting to the qualified electors of the District the following proposition:
Shall the following be adopted?
Shall Unified School District No. 476, Gray County, Kansas (Copeland), issue general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $5,600,000, to pay the costs to construct, furnish and equip a new elementary school addition, and all necessary improvements related thereto; all pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 10‑101 et seq ., K.S.A. 25‑2018(f), K.S.A. 72‑5457, and K.S.A. 72‑5458 et seq .?
To vote in favor of any question submitted on this ballot, press the word “Yes” on the voting machine or completely darken the oval to the left of the word “Yes” on the paper ballot. To vote against it, press the word “No” on the voting machine or completely darken the oval to the left of the word “No” on the paper ballot.
